title: Internship at Atmar
text: First job experience. Learned about server hardware, product assembly, and gained foundational understanding of enterprise IT infrastructure.

title: Technician Replacement
text: On-call technician covering for the main technician. Hardware troubleshooting, server maintenance, and supporting the technical team during peak periods.

title: Main Technician / Product Manager
text: Leading technical operations and managing product development. Overseeing hardware projects, coordinating with teams, and driving product strategy.
